# 2 Baruch Chapter 23 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** I answered, "Lord, I have told you what I know, and I've learned from you what I didn't know.

**2** You said before that you know the number of those who will be born — how many there will be, how many have already come, and how many are still to come.

**3** But let me say this much: just as an unborn child has no idea when it will emerge into the world, and just as the dying do not know the hour when they will leave it —

**4** In the same way, human beings have no idea when you will come to visit them."

**5** Then I asked him, "Are there really souls being held in reserve in a heavenly treasury, waiting until the number is complete before they come forth?"

**6** He answered me, "Every soul that is now alive, every soul that has already departed, and every soul yet to be born — all of them are with him.

**7** For the Most High did not make this world except for the sake of the many; but the one who is coming will not come until the number that has been decreed is filled."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of the treasury of souls concept. The vivid womb-to-tomb analogy highlights human ignorance of God's timing. Baruch's question in v.5 is direct and bold — he is pressing God for the mechanics of the end.*
